scenario: Questionnaire sidebar, scrolled down, then click Settings
assertions: After navigation, scrollTop and clicked link screen top stay within 1 CSS pixel of their pre-click values
scope: Local Chromium navigation check; no FW instance changes

flicker_followup.cause: The parser-blocking external sidebar script could arrive after an initial paint, displaying the default collapsed tree and scrollTop=0 before restoring the saved state
flicker_followup.reproduction: Chrome/Cypress: force an uncached sidebar script URL and delay its response 700ms; sample sidebar positions with requestAnimationFrame during navigation

before_fix.evidence: Cypress assertion: scroll variation during rendering was 377px; allowed <2px

flicker_followup.fix: Include the same single restoration script inline from a Jinja template immediately after the navigation tree; no external sidebar script request or duplicate implementation
flicker_followup.scope: Local Chrome rendering and final-position regression. This is narrower than a claim covering every browser/navigation path

search_logo_followup.reproduction: Chrome/Cypress, uncached light/dark SVG logo URLs delayed 900ms; search-container position sampled on animation frames
search_logo_followup.cause: Logo images had no intrinsic width/height attributes; their container was initially zero height and expanded once the SVG loaded
search_logo_followup.fix: Set width=1000 height=159 from both logo SVG viewBoxes; responsive CSS width:100%, height:auto preserves their aspect ratio before load
search_logo_followup.verification: Strict HTML build and four Chrome regressions passed (light/dark delayed logo, menu transient frames, final menu position)
search_logo_followup.scope: Local guide at port 8769, Chrome 156. No claim of testing every browser
